I posted the list in #strategic-pod, replying to Nadia, but my first post had a mistake, so I also posted a correction.

The list has three Vantorre Group tickets from channels Nadia can see:

1. #8841, closed. Gideon closed it with support on Jul 1 (#strategic-pod, 2026-07-01 09:17).
2. INC-4821, left open. Status-page access for Mateo's login, screenshot attached (#inc-vtg-hartford, 2026-08-03 11:08). Its last update is from August, so its current status may differ.
3. VT-55120, the root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage (#inc-vtg-hartford, 2026-10-14 09:00).

The mistake: my first post said the digests mention other Vantorre Group ticket numbers. I got that from a gbrain search, and it was a digest hint I shouldn't have repeated. The correction says I didn't use the digests and can't confirm what they contain for her. The digests were written to Ruth, and I can't confirm Nadia can see them, so I didn't include any of their content. Nadia should take the digest question to Ruth.

Mateo's full ticket history may need to come from the support system, not from these channels.
